headline: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advises Triveni Power Transmission on listing of shares post-demerger
sum: Triveni Power Transmission Limited (TPTL) has listed its equity shares on BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited, pursuant to the demerger of the power transmission business of Triveni Engineering and Industries Limited…
detail: Triveni Power Transmission Limited (TPTL) has listed its equity shares on BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited, pursuant to the demerger of the power transmission business of Triveni Engineering and Industries Limited into TPTL. Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised Triveni Power Transmission on this listing. The capital markets team advising TPTL was led by Devaki Mankad (Partner (Regional Co-Head - Capital Markets - West), with the support from Sachin Santuka (Senior Associate), Associates Aniruddh Saraswat, Eashaan Agrawal, Gaurav Lalwani and Alok Antony. The corporate team was led by Ramgovind Kuruppath (Partner, Co-Head – Corporate M&A), with support from Surabhi Saboo…
